facts.fact: The article reports a government delegate at a February 2026 workshop in Bujumbura citing Burundi's cybercrime law, Law No. 1/10 of 16 March 2022 on prevention and repression of cybercrime, as adopted and in application, with experts and participants discussing its enforcement and gaps against the Malabo Convention; a speaker says the president signed it in 2022.
facts.system: Loi n°1/10 du 16 mars 2022 portant prévention et répression de la cybercriminalité

note: No dated arrest, charge, prosecution or published case count under the law is stated, so no use fact; the Malabo ratification call is noted only.
